description: Adds or updates shares for a dashboard, specifying users and groups along with their access rules.

dashboard_id.description: The ID of the dashboard to which the shares will be added.

shares.description: A list of dictionaries, each containing: - "name" (str): The username or group name. - "type" (str): Either "user" or "group" to indicate the share type. - "rule" (str): The access level (e.g., "view", "edit").

examples.user_query: How can I share the Sales Dashboard with the sales team and give them view access?
examples.notes: This call shares the Sales Dashboard with the 'sales_team' group, granting them view-only access.

examples.user_query: I need to give John Doe edit access to the Marketing Dashboard. How can I do that?
examples.notes: This call grants John Doe edit access to the Marketing Dashboard.

examples.user_query: Can I share the Operations Dashboard with both the operations team and Jane Smith, giving them different access levels?
examples.notes: This call shares the Operations Dashboard with the 'operations_team' group (view access) and Jane Smith (edit access).

description: Retrieves share details (users and groups) for a specific dashboard by title.

dashboard_name.description: The title of the dashboard to retrieve share information for.

examples.user_query: Who has access to the 'Sales Overview' dashboard?
examples.notes: Retrieves the list of users and groups that have access to the 'Sales Overview' dashboard. Use this to audit or review sharing permissions.

examples.user_query: Can you show me the sharing details for the 'Marketing Performance' dashboard?
examples.notes: Fetches the sharing details for the 'Marketing Performance' dashboard, including users and groups with access. Useful for understanding who can view this dashboard.

examples.user_query: I need to check the sharing settings for the 'Executive Summary' dashboard.
examples.notes: Provides the sharing information for the 'Executive Summary' dashboard. This is helpful for verifying or troubleshooting access permissions.

description: Retrieve share details for a dashboard using the v1 shares endpoint.

examples.user_query: Who has access to the sales performance dashboard?
examples.notes: This retrieves the share details for the 'sales performance' dashboard, including users and groups with access. Admin access is enabled to include all details.

examples.user_query: Can you show me the sharing settings for the marketing overview dashboard?
examples.notes: This retrieves the share details for the 'marketing overview' dashboard without admin-level access, showing only the user's accessible share information.

examples.user_query: I need to verify who owns the executive summary dashboard and who it is shared with.
examples.notes: This retrieves the share details for the 'executive summary' dashboard, including ownership and all sharing details, with admin access enabled.
